sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《CA-Net: Comprehensive Attention Convolutional Neural Networks for Explainable Medical Image Segmentation》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance for automatic medical image segmentation.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Extensive experiments on skin lesion segmentation from ISIC 2018 and multi-class segmentation of fetal MRI found that our proposed CA-Net significantly improved the average segmentation Dice score from 87.77% to 92.08% for skin lesion, 84.79% to 87.08% for the placenta and 93.20% to 95.88% for the fetal brain respectively compared with U-Net.

evidence.text: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance for automatic medical image segmentation.

Extensive experiments on skin lesion segmentation from ISIC 2018 and multi-class segmentation of fetal MRI found that our proposed CA-Net significantly improved the average segmentation Dice score from 87.77% to 92.08% for skin lesion, 84.79% to 87.08% for the placenta and 93.20% to 95.88% for the fetal brain respectively compared with U-Net.
